entities.name: N-H fused heteroarene ester
observations: Decoded as COC(=O)c1c(C)nc2[nH]ccc2c1-c1ccc(C)cc1; contains an N-H fused azaindole-like heteroarene suitable for N-alkylation.

entities.name: Fluoro chlorobenzyl bromide
observations: Decoded as FC1=CC(Cl)=CC=C1CBr; the benzylic C-Br bond is the electrophilic site, while aryl F and Cl are retained.

entities.name: N-benzylation of fused heteroarene
observations: Base-promoted SN2 alkylation of the heteroaromatic [nH] with the fluoro/chlorobenzyl bromide gives the N-CH2-aryl product.
The supplied reaction database match reports product SMILES COC(=O)c1c(C)nc2c(ccn2Cc2ccc(Cl)cc2F)c1-c1ccc(C)cc1.

entities.name: N-benzylated fused ester
observations: The product retains the methyl ester, aryl methyl substituents, and aryl F/Cl; the heteroaromatic N-H is replaced by N-CH2-(chloro-fluorophenyl).
